pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of reviews to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 50 reviews will be returned. The maximum value is 200; values above 200 will be coerced to 200.

filter.description: Optional. A filter to apply to the reviews. Only equality comparison on rating is supported, e.g. `rating = 5`.

orderBy.description: Optional. An optional comma-separated list of fields by which to sort the results. Supported fields are `rating` and `create_time`. Supported orders are `asc` (default) and `desc`. Example: "rating desc, create_time".

name.description: Required. The item resource name whose reviews are being fetched. Format: publishers/{publisher_id}/items/{item_id}

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token, received from a previous `FetchItemReviews` call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters provided to `FetchItemReviews` must match the call that provided the page token.

cancelSubmission.description: Cancel the current active submission of an item if present. This can be used to cancel the review of a pending submission.

setPublishedDeployPercentage.description: Set a higher target deploy percentage for the item's published revision. This will be updated without the item being submitted for review. This is only available to items with over 10,000 seven-day active users.
